stories.headline: Trump repeatedly attacks Starmer over Iran war stance, calling PM 'no Winston Churchill'
stories.summary: President Trump has launched sustained public criticism of PM Keir Starmer for refusing to fully support the US-Israel war on Iran, with Trump saying Starmer is 'no Winston Churchill' and expressing disappointment in the UK's limited involvement.
